headline: Tyson Foods (TSN) Lags Q3 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
summary: Tyson (TSN) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of -3.88% and -1.92%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
